notes: This contract pins the official C++ timestamped Update Attribute Values and Reflect Attribute Values callback declarations used by the bounded regional TSO scenario. It also records the official Time Advance Request, Retract, and Request Retraction surfaces used to establish grant/retraction boundaries. The shared recipient planner requires active overlapping regional attribute triples; passive triples remain retained without arranging reflection, although these timestamped cases do not independently test that selector. The Catch2 cases exercise one immediate recipient and one time-constrained recipient, including pending constrained-recipient suppression, Request Retraction for the delivered nonconstrained recipient, and recipient-gated sent-region metadata; a separate disjoint-region case proves the qualifying no-overlap returned-designator path. The profile remains non-installable and does not claim default-region synthesis, alternate advance modes, remote transport, save/restore persistence, package evidence, protected review, or conformance.
